01 / ABOUT BIT

A PLACE TO LEARN.
A FOUNDATION TO GROW.

Birgunj Institute of Technology is a CTEVT-affiliated technical institute in Birgunj-14, Parsa. Since 2000, BIT has offered diploma-level technical education with a focus on practical learning and skill development.

Discover an engineering education that brings together classroom study, laboratory work and practical experience.

Practical learningHands-on training
to build real skills.

for practical learning.
